Here’s a warm but professional follow-up email you could send to Rudy after your call. fileciteturn0file0

:::writing{variant="email" id="48271" subject="Excited to Continue the Conversation"}
Hi Rudy,

Thank you again for taking the time to meet with us today. As always, it was great speaking with you, and we truly appreciate your honesty and transparency about where things currently stand financially and operationally on your end.

First and foremost, we completely understand your hesitation with the laser repair expense and the current unpredictability in the market. We know these are not small decisions, especially when you're trying to make smart, sustainable moves for the practice long term.

That said, we genuinely believe in what you and Carrie are building, especially with the peptide launch coming up. Based on everything we've discussed over our last few conversations, we truly feel there is a strong opportunity for growth and that we could help you roll this out strategically and successfully when the timing aligns.

As mentioned on the call, we are currently holding our existing pricing structure for you while we evaluate upcoming changes internally. We also discussed a few flexible options that may help make things feel more manageable, including:
• Breaking the investment into multiple payments
• A possible good-faith deposit option to help reserve your spot
• Financing/payment flexibility if needed

No pressure whatsoever. We simply wanted to provide options while keeping the door open for you.

Whenever you have a chance, feel free to send over your peptide menu and rollout plans. We would genuinely be happy to take a look and offer feedback, recommendations, pricing guidance, or any insight that could help you feel more confident heading into launch, regardless of timing with us.

Enjoy your weekend, and we hope things begin settling down on your end soon. We’ll stay in touch, and we look forward to reconnecting after we get back.

Excited for what’s ahead for you guys.

Bethany Anne  
Co-Founder & CEO | The Luxora Collective  
Growth Partners for Med Spa Owners Ready to Scale  
📧 bethany@theluxoracollective.co  
🌐 theluxoracollective.co
:::
